summary: Review feature flags and rollout controls for default behavior, kill switches, cohort consistency, cleanup, schema compatibility and rollback safety.

must_inspect.why: Flagged old/new paths must coexist safely across rollout and rollback windows.
false_positive_guards: Do not demand dual-write when the rollout architecture does not require shared state compatibility.

must_inspect.why: A flag used as a safety control must actually contain the risky effect and be operable under failure.
false_positive_guards: A feature flag is not automatically a rollback mechanism for irreversible data changes.
Treat this pack as review configuration, not as evidence or an automatic severity increase.
